title: Apps, Links and QR Codes
intro: Ten apps, links and QR codes. One minute.
Swipe left if it's dangerous, right if it's safe.
Not every QR code is a trap.

cards.text: New! Pay parking by QR (sticker on top of the old one).
cards.why: Fake QR stickers on top of real ones lead to fake payment sites.

cards.text: "Pondra Wallet Pro": 3K users, published last week, asks to read all websites.
cards.why: Fake wallet extensions copy real names and steal phrases.

cards.text: Hedrio update 7.2: bug fixes. Installed from your usual app store.
cards.why: An update to the real app, from the store you already use.

cards.text: Download Lumveo so our agent can fix your wallet remotely.
cards.why: Remote-access apps let scammers control your device.

cards.text: Scan for the menu (printed on the table card). Opens kopicorner.eu/menu.
cards.why: A menu QR that opens the café's own site and asks for nothing.

cards.text: Scan to claim 50 ZLV free! Connect your wallet.
cards.why: A QR that asks you to connect your wallet for free coins is a drainer.

cards.text: Setting up an authenticator app for Ostrel, from Ostrel's own security page.
cards.why: Moving codes to an app protects you from SIM swaps.

cards.text: Install "Walvio" to keep all your wallets in one place. Enter phrases to begin.
cards.why: Any app that collects your phrases is stealing them.

cards.text: This is the authenticator app I use, here's its page in the official store.
cards.why: A friend sharing an official store page and asking nothing.

cards.text: Free "Pro" version of a paid trading app! Download the APK here.
cards.why: Cracked apps from random links often carry malware that steals wallets.

golden_rule: Install apps only from official stores via official links, and check where a QR code takes you before you act.

quick_check.q: A sticker QR code on a parking meter covers another one. What should you do?

options.text: Use the official parking app or the meter itself

quick_check.explain: Stuck-on QR codes are a common trick.
